pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/datasets.rs:1 The context's "change detection" means diffing scraped records (SHA-256 value hashes, simhash/dom_simhash near-duplicate fingerprints) across scrape runs, not reading a team's VCS change history; a case-insensitive search of crates/core/src and crates/core/tests for pull_request, co-authored-by, change_failure, review_coverage and merge_commit found zero hits, so none of the subject's techniques (attribution, review coverage, revert linkage, batch size, denominators) has a precondition here.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/simhash.rs:1 The module fingerprints documents for near-duplicate detection; it computes no failure or revert signal from commit history.
